column8: ["Give the broad amber housing richer glaze pooling, fine crazing and selectively worn edges; its orange finish currently feels too uniform.","Distinguish the seat materials more clearly: cooler tarnished brass, matte rubber lips and sharper ceramic highlights would make the construction more tangible.","Develop the central collar into a more characterful focal fitting with deliberate tooling and asymmetric wear.","Vary the small fittings with crisp fastener heads and accumulated grime so their detail reads as crafted hardware rather than repeated bumps."]

["Give the central brass collar clearer facets and sharper worn edges; its mottled surface currently blurs the machine's focal point.","Deepen a few broad shadows beneath the rim and fittings to make the glazed body feel thicker and heavier.","Differentiate the rubber seats from their brass surrounds with matte dark surfaces and selective metallic glints; the repeated rings currently share a similar softness."]
